wording: P107's sample sizes add up (5512 by country and by subsample), its odds ratios are geometric means of their CIs within rounding (maximum log deviation 0.045), and its correlation ranges match Table 2. Three pre-registered checks are not supported: the whole-sample affiliation percentages add to 89, not 100; two odds ratios are marked significant although their 95% CIs reach or include 1 (India, love and cannabis, 0.44, 0.19-1.00; US, altruism and alcohol, 0.53, 0.27-1.01); and the text's 35-49% reduction in suicidal ideation for love does not match Table 4, whose India OR 0.41 implies 59%.
counterevidence_limits: CI rounding may explain the 1.00 case; the 11% gap in affiliations may be undisclosed categories. P107 also cites 'Table 3' for correlations shown in Table 2.
operationalization: SOC Transcendence = audit of a cross-cultural survey
